summary.text: Bias shepherd of the host, whom Nestor arrayed with mighty Pelagon, Alastor, Chromius, and lord Haemon when Poseidon roused the Achaeans — distinct from Bias son of Amythaon and from the Dulichian suitor.

story.text: Nestor the clear-voiced orator drew up his Pylians around mighty Pelagon and Alastor and Chromius and lord Haemon and Bias, shepherd of the host — the charioteers first with horses and cars, then footmen many and valiant to be a bulwark of battle.
